data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'raah', meaning 'to love' or 'desirable'. In Islamic tradition, Mueerah symbolizes the love and compassion of Allah (swt) towards His creation. The name Mueerah carries the meaning “Desirable, Lovable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mueerah usually hope their child will grow to embody desirable, lovable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
